title: Cobar: two people killed in Endeavour mine explosion in far western NSW
summary: Woman and man confirmed dead and another woman airlifted to hospital after blast at underground Endeavour mine 600km north-west of Sydney Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Two people have been killed by an explosion at an underground mine in the far west of New South Wales. Police said emergency services were called to the mine on Endeavour Mine Road at Cobar, about 600km north-west of Sydney, at about 3.45am on Wednesday after being told two people had been critically injured in a workplace incident.
